summary: A scheduled or queued job: registered in every list the runtime reads, with a consumer, idempotent under overlap, and its wake-up cost stated.

required_inputs.name: job
required_inputs.description: Task or endpoint name and where it lives

required_inputs.name: trigger
required_inputs.description: Beat schedule, cron expression, queue name, or HTTP trigger

required_inputs.name: overlap_behavior
required_inputs.description: What happens if two runs overlap or a run repeats: skip, dedupe key, or safe by construction

required_inputs.name: cost_posture
required_inputs.description: What the schedule wakes: a database, a paid API, a browser

checklist.rule: The job is in every list the runtime reads: the explicit imports tuple, task_routes, the cron case table and the all list, or the launchd plist
checklist.because: Flex crons.yml is the only scheduler and a route missing from either list never runs; r3cruit3r celery_config imports tuple is explicit; nothing else notices

checklist.rule: A consumer exists for the queue or schedule: a fly.toml process group, a GitHub Actions cron, a launchd job
checklist.because: A routed Celery task with no worker on its queue waits forever; r3cruit3r queues map to fly.toml process groups

checklist.rule: Two overlapping or repeated runs produce one effect: a dedupe key, a claim row, or an operation that is safe to repeat
checklist.because: GitHub scheduled triggers lag and duplicate; Flex crons are documented as idempotent for that reason; LINDA pipeline_ledger exists because overlap double-spent

checklist.rule: Database and tenant work goes through the sanctioned runner: async_runner.run_async, tenant_context, or the repo equivalent
checklist.because: r3cruit3r Celery tasks that opened their own loop leaked connections; LINDA Celery entry points must arm the tenant GUC or RLS returns zero rows

checklist.rule: Every new wake-up states what it wakes and how often; no new beat entry outside the minimal list without that statement
checklist.because: r3cruit3r BEAT_MINIMAL_TASKS and test_neon_cost_posture exist because beat entries kept Neon awake and billed

checklist.rule: An HTTP-triggered job verifies the shared secret first and fails closed when it is unset
checklist.because: Flex cron guards once returned true with no secret, making paid endpoints world-callable; verifyCronSecret now fails closed

checklist.rule: An HTTP-triggered job returns JSON on every path, including errors
checklist.because: Flex crons.yml treats a 200 with a non-JSON body as a route that never executed, since a missing route returns the HTML 404 page

checklist.rule: A paid step claims an exactly-once ledger row before spending
The done output pastes the registration proof: the task in app.tasks, the route in both crons.yml lists, the process group in fly.toml
checklist.because: A green test suite does not prove a schedule fires; only the registries do

done_output: cost posture: what wakes and how often
trigger auth line quoted for HTTP jobs
stop_conditions: no consumer exists and the task does not add one
the job would add a beat entry outside the minimal list without an operator ruling
the trigger has no secret configured

adapter_fields.name: registries
adapter_fields.description: Every list the runtime reads and how to check membership

adapter_fields.name: runner_fn
adapter_fields.description: The sanctioned runner for DB and tenant work

adapter_fields.name: consumer_map
adapter_fields.description: Queue or schedule to consumer: fly.toml process groups, Actions cron, launchd

adapter_fields.name: posture_tests
adapter_fields.description: Tests that fail on a new wake-up outside the minimal list

adapter_fields.name: minimal_schedule_list
adapter_fields.description: The allow-list of beat entries, if the repo has one

adapter_fields.name: trigger_auth_fn
adapter_fields.description: The secret check for HTTP-triggered jobs
